The Final Battle (Japanese: 最終決戦 The Last Battle) is the 547th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 23rd chapter of the .

It is subtitled Crushed Ambition (Japanese: クラッシュド・アンビション Crushed Ambition).

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
returns 's Pokémon to him.
entrusts Gigi to to help her find , before sending her onto the Plasma Frigate.
Whitley encounters Hugh, who apologizes to her and tells he's come to find N as well.
Whitley and Hugh find N and free him.
N agrees to return the that was stolen from Hugh's sister after Ghetsis is defeated.
In Undella Town, Cedric Juniper and help and Benga to break out of the frozen Marine Tube.
Cheren's is revealed to have evolved into .
Kelden tries to strike down Colress, but its attack instead hits the Reveal Glass, breaking it.
With the Reveal Glass broken, the revert to their Incarnate Formes and are defeated by the , along with the Shadow Triad.
The Forces of Nature escape, freed from Team Plasma's control.
Hugh stays to battle the s who stole Purrloin, while N and Whitley head to face Ghetsis.
and find Alder and , who have defeated most of Ghetsis's Pokémon.
N confronts Ghetsis in a storage room full of Poké Balls containing the Pokémon liberated by Team Plasma and swears to return all the "liberated" Pokémon to their s.
Looker tries to arrest Ghetsis, but he says he'll rather go down with his dream than be taken captive.
An explosion tears the Plasma Frigate open, causing all the Poké Balls inside to fall out.
Hugh saves a from the Team Plasma Grunts he chased.
N tries to save Ghetsis from falling from the Plasma Frigate, but Ghetsis attacks him and calls him a monster.
Ghetsis is saved from his fall by .
separates from itself and leaves.
, , and Iris pursue the Plasma Frigate on Reshiram.
Colress is revealed to be controlling the through an improved Colress Machine held by his .
's Pokémon destroy the Colress Machine, and Blake defeats Colress with the help of .
Kyurem briefly returns to freeze Colress solid, allowing Looker to take him into custody.
The Plasma Frigate collides with N's Castle, setting it on fire.
The Unova first partner Pokémon families gather and combine their pledge moves in order to put out the fire.
Ghetsis is taken into custody.
Kyurem freezes over the Giant Chasm in order to rest peacefully.
Hugh's sister gets her Purrloin back.
Reshiram and Zekrom leave Black and N, respectively.

==Trivia==
This chapter was published as two separate chapters online. The first part of the first was released on November 29, 2019 and the second part was released on December 27, 2019. The first part of the second was released on January 31, 2020, the second part on February 28, 2020, the third part on March 28, 2020, and the fourth and final part on April 17, 2020.
At 89 pages, this is the longest chapter in Pokémon Adventures.
